reference_sql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) AS event_day
  FROM orders
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) AS DATE)
  FROM competitor_prices
)
SELECT event_day, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM events
WHERE event_day BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-12' AND DATE '2025-05-18'
GROUP BY event_day
alternatives: WITH order_days AS (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) AS event_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY 1), check_days AS (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) AS DATE) AS event_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM competitor_prices GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(o.event_day, c.event_day) AS event_day, COALESCE(o.n, 0) + COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS events FROM order_days o FULL OUTER JOIN check_days c ON c.event_day = o.event_day WHERE COALESCE(o.event_day, c.event_day) BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-12' AND DATE '2025-05-18'

WITH events AS (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) AS DATE) AS event_day FROM competitor_prices UNION ALL SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) FROM orders) SELECT event_day, COUNT(*) AS events FROM events WHERE event_day >= DATE '2025-05-12' AND event_day < DATE '2025-05-19' GROUP BY 1

WITH order_days AS (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) AS event_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY 1), check_days AS (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) AS DATE) AS event_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM competitor_prices GROUP BY 1), stacked AS (SELECT event_day, n FROM order_days UNION ALL SELECT event_day, n FROM check_days) SELECT event_day, SUM(n) AS events FROM stacked WHERE event_day BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-12' AND DATE '2025-05-18' GROUP BY event_day

other_way.sql: WITH order_days AS (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE) AS event_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY 1), check_days AS (SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', observed_ts)) AS DATE) AS event_day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM competitor_prices GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(o.event_day, c.event_day) AS event_day, COALESCE(o.n, 0) + COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS events FROM order_days o FULL OUTER JOIN check_days c ON c.event_day = o.event_day WHERE COALESCE(o.event_day, c.event_day) BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-12' AND DATE '2025-05-18'
other_way.tradeoff: A FULL OUTER JOIN of two per-day counts gives the same totals, but it needs COALESCE wherever one side has no rows.

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT CAST((order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS DATE) AS event_day FROM orders
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST((observed_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS DATE) AS event_day FROM competitor_prices
)
SELECT event_day, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM ev
WHERE event_day BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-12' AND DATE '2025-05-18'
GROUP BY event_day
